answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 7245 Country: India Title: Kindly help by clarifying in the light of various books that after having sex twice in the same night is one Gusal enough or should we perform two gusals? Question: Assalau alaikum, Kindly help by clarifying in the light of various books that after having sex twice in the same night is one Gusal enough or should we perform two gusals? Answer ID: 7245 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 861/861=M/1429) One ghusl is enough for two or more intercourses. However, it is desirable ( mustahab ) to make wudhu or ghusl before next intercourse. And, when one did ghusl after one intercourse then he or she has to make new ghusl after the next intercourse: عن انس کان النبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم یطوف علی نسائہ بغسل واحد۔ (صحیح مسلم ) و عن ابی سعید الخدری رضی اللہ عنہ قال: قال النبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: اذا اتی احدکم اھلہ ثم اراد ان یعود فلیتوضا بینھما وضوءً۔ ( مشکوۃ ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
